label: kizuna_rival_c_01
text: Better stock up real good on Poké Balls while\nI’m here...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: kizuna_rival_c_03
text: Oh my gosh, listen to this. Remember that guy\nfrom the cafeteria?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: kizuna_rival_c_04
text: I ran into him again in the entrance hall, so I\nasked him to battle...but he said no![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: kizuna_rival_c_05
text: He was like, “What’s the point? You’re a\nChampion and a battle whiz—you’d wreck me!”[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: kizuna_rival_c_06
text: I don’t get what he meant! I mean, you can have\nfun battling even if you lose, right?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: kizuna_rival_c_07a
text: For real! I mean, sure, no one loves losing, but\nit’s definitely not pointless. It teaches you stuff![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: kizuna_rival_c_07b
text: Yeeeah, I guess so... Obviously I’d rather win than\nlose, but I just think it’s better to go into things\r\nwith a “losing can be fun, too” attitude![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: kizuna_rival_c_08
text: Man... Pokémon battles can get so complicated\nsometimes.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: kizuna_rival_c_09
text: Oh, and I wish he hadn’t called me a whiz!\nI work hard at this stuff. It’s not like it all just\r\ncomes naturally to me![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: kizuna_rival_c_10
text: Like, throwing Poké Balls obviously doesn’t come\nnaturally to me, for one thing...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: kizuna_rival_c_11
text: I think I need a mental reset. I’m gonna go find\nsomeone to battle![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
